what: A four-corner bracket frame (corner 6px·line 1px) slides to the size of the hovered item in a logo·card group with .8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), and when first entering the group it turns on after .1s, blinking three times .08s apart. It turns off in .2s when leaving the group

options.pad: Px to spread the frame outside the item, default 0
options.--fx-color: CSS variable — bracket color, default text color

from.where: index.html .hm-partners (partner logos, 18 cells) — original c-hover-anchor-position__frame (210×162 frame, transform .8s, blink2 .08s × 3)

note: The original frame has a fixed size (210×162), but the parts follow the item size. Not applied on touch devices
